description: The canonical `sensing:` error vocabulary. Rust owns the classification (net_sdk::sensing::SensingError::kind / is_terminal / to_wire); every language binding surfaces it verbatim and asserts against these vectors. A binding MUST recover `kind` from `wire` (prefix `sensing:`, the kind runs to the first `: `), MUST report `terminal` exactly as listed, and MUST NOT derive either from the message. GENERATED - do not hand-edit; regenerate with: NET_REGENERATE_SENSING_FIXTURE=1 cargo test -p net-mesh-sdk --features net --lib sensing::class::tests::the_checked_in_fixture_matches_the_classifier

vectors.message: capability sensing is disabled on this mesh — build it with MeshBuilder::enable_sensing()
vectors.wire: sensing:disabled: capability sensing is disabled on this mesh — build it with MeshBuilder::enable_sensing()

vectors.message: provider readiness needs a persisted sensing incarnation — derive one with net_sdk::sensing::next_incarnation over durable storage and pass it to MeshBuilder::sensing_incarnation()
vectors.wire: sensing:incarnation_required: provider readiness needs a persisted sensing incarnation — derive one with net_sdk::sensing::next_incarnation over durable storage and pass it to MeshBuilder::sensing_incarnation()

vectors.message: a readiness evaluator is already registered for capability `fixture.capability` — close that registration or call provide_replacing to supersede it
vectors.wire: sensing:already_providing: a readiness evaluator is already registered for capability `fixture.capability` — close that registration or call provide_replacing to supersede it

vectors.message: provider readiness needs a durable node identity — build the mesh with MeshBuilder::identity(..) instead of the generated ephemeral keypair
vectors.wire: sensing:durable_identity_required: provider readiness needs a durable node identity — build the mesh with MeshBuilder::identity(..) instead of the generated ephemeral keypair

vectors.message: this node's readiness-registration identity space is exhausted — no further provider registration can be installed on it
vectors.wire: sensing:registration_identity_exhausted: this node's readiness-registration identity space is exhausted — no further provider registration can be installed on it

vectors.message: a sensing query needs a capability name — the same id the provider passes to SensingClient::provide
vectors.wire: sensing:empty_capability: a sensing query needs a capability name — the same id the provider passes to SensingClient::provide

vectors.message: a zero end-to-end budget admits no provider — pass the request's real deadline to SensingQuery::within, or leave the budget unbounded
vectors.wire: sensing:unsatisfiable_budget: a zero end-to-end budget admits no provider — pass the request's real deadline to SensingQuery::within, or leave the budget unbounded

vectors.message: observing capability readiness needs a live installed organization authority on this node — adopt one (net_sdk::org::provision) and install it before watching, and retry if it is being rotated
vectors.wire: sensing:no_organization_authority: observing capability readiness needs a live installed organization authority on this node — adopt one (net_sdk::org::provision) and install it before watching, and retry if it is being rotated

vectors.message: this node is not currently entitled to observe capability readiness — its own organization membership is absent, expired, revoked below the current floor, or its authority view is unreadable; snapshots resume once membership is valid again AND the authority view is readable and stable
vectors.wire: sensing:observer_not_qualified: this node is not currently entitled to observe capability readiness — its own organization membership is absent, expired, revoked below the current floor, or its authority view is unreadable; snapshots resume once membership is valid again AND the authority view is readable and stable

vectors.message: a zero provider-start bound can never be satisfied — pass the real bound to SensingQuery::start_within
vectors.wire: sensing:unsatisfiable_start_bound: a zero provider-start bound can never be satisfied — pass the real bound to SensingQuery::start_within

vectors.message: this observation root already retains the maximum number of capabilities — the node's observation state is exhausted
vectors.wire: sensing:watches_at_capacity: this observation root already retains the maximum number of capabilities — the node's observation state is exhausted

vectors.message: this node can no longer mint an observation identity — no further capability watch can be established on it
vectors.wire: sensing:observation_identity_unavailable: this node can no longer mint an observation identity — no further capability watch can be established on it

vectors.message: this capability watch is closed — open a new one with SensingClient::watch
vectors.wire: sensing:watch_closed: this capability watch is closed — open a new one with SensingClient::watch

vectors.message: no member of this organization can lead sensing for this capability right now — retry later, or open an exact watch (drop SensingQuery::coalesced) to sense the providers directly
vectors.wire: sensing:no_sensing_leader: no member of this organization can lead sensing for this capability right now — retry later, or open an exact watch (drop SensingQuery::coalesced) to sense the providers directly

vectors.message: a coalesced watch asks for 1 to 32 providers — pass Coalesced::Best or Coalesced::Top(k) with k in 1..=32
vectors.wire: sensing:unsatisfiable_coalescing: a coalesced watch asks for 1 to 32 providers — pass Coalesced::Best or Coalesced::Top(k) with k in 1..=32

vectors.message: a sensing capability name may be at most 1024 bytes — use the provider's own capability id
vectors.wire: sensing:capability_too_long: a sensing capability name may be at most 1024 bytes — use the provider's own capability id
